# Silver Spoon Diner — Third-Party Asset Sources

This manifest covers the downloaded source assets retained for the Silver Spoon Diner. All entries were downloaded on **2026-07-29** and are licensed under **Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal**.

Project-authored fixture GLBs are generated locally using project-authored geometry and the external CC0 PBR maps credited below. Those GLBs are project derivatives, not third-party model downloads; the credited third-party inputs are the applicable material/texture sets.
